definitions.explanation: A sour liquid made through fermentation, used as a condiment and in cooking. Essential for sushi rice.

examples.japanese: {寿司|すし}には{酢|す}を{使|つか}います。
サラダに{酢|す}をかけます。
examples.english: I put vinegar on the salad.

examples.japanese: {酢|す}は{体|からだ}にいいと{言|い}われています。
examples.english: It's said that vinegar is good for your health.

notes: 酢 is one of the basic seasonings in Japanese cooking. 米酢 (こめず, rice vinegar) is the most common type. 酢飯 (すめし) is the seasoned rice used for sushi. The word 酢の物 (すのもの) refers to vinegared dishes.
